cards.headline: The tape: a broad bid, 58% of energy names green
cards.body: SPX +0.28% · WTI +2.07% · Brent -2.89% · NatGas +11.90%. 58% of 67 energy names are green — a broad bid. Grid, Storage & Electrification is doing the heavy lifting at +2.12%.

cards.headline: Grid, Storage & Electrification leads, Oilfield Services lags
cards.body: Strongest energy sector is Grid, Storage & Electrification at +2.12%; weakest is Oilfield Services at -1.99%. Rotation within the energy trade, not a one-way move.

cards.headline: ENPH is the standout at -16.33%
cards.body: Leaders: VRT +13.04%, PWR +7.80%, EOSE +6.59%, NXT +5.54%, UEC +4.35%. Laggards: ENPH -16.33%, SEDG -9.42%, BKR -6.99%, NOV -6.23%.
cards.watch: Hot means attention, not direction — watch whether the leaders hold the bid or fade into the next session.

cards.headline: ENPH moving on no clear catalyst
cards.body: ENPH is -16.33% with no fresh headline this cycle — attention without a story. Volume, not news, is doing the work.
